v0.1.1.description:
Patch Notes:
- Made Key 8's secondary spawn location require extreme item logic (was complex)
- Made Showroom items require being able to access enough gold
- Made digging up items only be considered on extreme logic
- Trying to gen with empty filler item distribution (or empty trap distribution when traps are on) will now throw an OptionError
- Fixed regions past the goal still being created
- Fixed an incorrect region connection from Rotating Gear to Abandoned Mine

As this is an Alpha, expect issues and please report them when you encounter them on GitHub Issues or in the appropriate Discord Channel/Thread.
